text.p: Tenneco Automotive, a unit of Tenneco Inc, said Tuesday it is reorganizing by establishing six operating units and adding new management.

It said automotive's new structure will include two operating units in North America, Tenneco Automotive Original Equipment and Tenneco Automotive Aftermarket; two in Europe, Tenneco Automotive/Monroe Europe and Tenneco Automotive/Walker Europe.
Also included are two additional operating units, Tenneco Automotive Asia Pacific Rim and Tenneco Automotive South America.

The company said its European organizations will immediately begin a transition migrating to the North American organizational model of original equipment and aftermarket units. This transition should be completed by the third quarter.
"Our new structure will enable us to maximize our strengths to better serve our original equipment and replacement market customers," said Tenneco Automotive president Thomas Evans.
